## Key mathematical decisions
- **Design dependency correction (recorded):** the main splitting lemma's statement/proof use truncation functors, t-cohomology, amplitude and boundedness, none of which existed in the published corpus (`def-canonical-t-structure-on-a-derived-category` defines t-structures only). Instead of editing published pages or the plan, I added the three local prerequisites on the same A page, sourced to BBD §1.3.1–1.3.7. All four planned claims, hypotheses and warnings are preserved (non-canonical splitting, primitive-lift caveat, self-duality $(W_i)^\perp=W_{-i-1}$).
- One design proof step citing "the cohomology sequence" was replaced by additivity + concentration identities, avoiding an unused import of BBD Théorème 1.3.6 (heart abelianness/LES). The main splitting proof was re-derived end to end at scaffold level (explicit $a,b,c,r,r'$, map detection, split triangle, complement $K_0$, $L_0=p[2]Li$, finite induction).
- No AC used anywhere; conventions fixed ($H^n_t=\tau_{\le n}\tau_{\ge n}[n]$, bounded = $X\in\mathcal T^{\le n}\cap\mathcal T^{\ge -n}$ for some $n$).
